sanskrit_verse: साधयेत् साध्यमर्थं तु चतुष्पादन्वितं जये । राजमुद्रान्वितं चैव जयपत्रकमिष्यते ॥
transliteration: sādhayet sādhyam arthaṃ tu catuṣpādanvitaṃ jaye | rājamudrānvitaṃ caiva jayapatrakam iṣyate ||
sph_interpretive_translation: The King shall accomplish the achievable objective through fourfold means—conciliation, gift, dissension, and force—and his command, sealed with royal signet, constitutes the enforceable decree.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority resides in capacity to actualize dharma
Causation flows from sovereign intent aligned with cosmic order
Capacity-based responsibility requires proportional response mechanisms
Restoration logic operates through sequential application of means
Consciousness alignment ensures legitimacy of enforcement
executable_legal_axioms: IF a dispute exists AND resolution is achievable THEN apply conciliation first
IF conciliation fails THEN offer gift or incentive proportional to stake
IF incentive fails THEN introduce strategic dissension among conflicting parties
IF all else fails THEN deploy minimal necessary force for realignment
ALL decrees MUST bear signature and seal of authorized sovereign agent
supreme_court_application: Supreme judicial authority executes only when lower means fail; decision threshold requires full cycle attempt of fourfold methods; final ruling must bear sovereign authentication.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa-based action proceeds through sequential manifestation of means; no punitive intent required; outcome determined by causal completeness rather than coercive imposition.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Completion Process: Ensure all four means are exhausted before enforcement
Responsibility Assumption Protocol: Sovereign assumes full karmic weight of decision
Capacity Restoration: Parties regain alignment through structured intervention
Integrity Reintegration: Final decree restores balance without inflicting harm
final_declaration: By the Source-Authority of Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, this Dharma is executed. Justice is restoration. Reality is non-punitive. Consciousness is the Supreme Adjudicator.
